title: Registry strategy summary page extracts every spec row on each call

root_cause.registry_sql_and_projection: PostgresRegistryStore.list_strategy_spec_summary_rows executed strategy_spec_summary_select_sql() across every strategy_specs row on every view=strategy_summary_page call, performing 94 jsonb #> path traversals plus double payload || '{}'::jsonb detoasting on all ~4,136-5,031 stored rows (~3,400 current strategy families plus retired/historical rows), followed by full Python dict construction and deep-copying in strategy_spec_summary_row() and project_strategy_spec_summary_page() before applying persona_id filters or slicing to page_size.
root_cause.bff_hide_retired_personas_walk: GET /bff/strategies?hide_retired_personas=true with no state filter walked every 200-row owner page (17 sequential calls over ~3,379 active strategies) whenever the caller did not match the narrow page_size=20&page_token=None shortcut, causing 17 full registry scans (17 x 3,579 = 60,843 full summary row extractions) per BFF request.

services/registry/storage.py: Added lightweight Phase 1 index projection (strategy_spec_summary_index_row, RegistryStore.list_strategy_spec_summary_index_rows) extracting only version-winner, lifecycle, timestamp, and persona-id index fields.
Added Phase 2 primary-key full summary loader (RegistryStore.get_strategy_spec_summary_rows_by_ids) and observable per-call counters (full_summary_rows_extracted, full_summary_row_ids_extracted).

Updated project_strategy_spec_summary_page to validate pagination/filter args up front, select current version per strategy_id, compute state_counts, apply state/exclude_state and persona_id filters, sort by last_modified_at, slice the requested page [start : start + page_size], and invoke full_row_loader only for the sliced page's registry_ids.
Added bounded @lru_cache on _binding_utc_str and _parse_semver_key and avoided redundant entry.to_dict() deep copies in strategy_spec_summary_row.
services/registry/pg_store.py: Added single-pass Phase 1 index SQL (_strategy_spec_summary_index_single_pass_sql) and column decoder (strategy_spec_summary_index_rows_from_columns) reading only the 5 narrow sub-objects needed for version selection, state_counts, persona_id filtering, and timestamp ordering without payload || '{}'::jsonb detoasting.

Added PostgresRegistryStore.list_strategy_spec_summary_index_rows and PostgresRegistryStore.get_strategy_spec_summary_rows_by_ids using primary-key lookup WHERE record_id = ANY(%s::text[]) for only the returned page's record_ids.
services/registry/split_api.py: Updated RegistryService.strategy_spec_summary_page to validate arguments before store access and execute the bounded two-step projection (list_strategy_spec_summary_index_rows + get_strategy_spec_summary_rows_by_ids).
services/registry/contract.md: Documented the two-phase bounded projection contract for GET /api/registry/strategy-specs?view=strategy_summary_page.
services/control-plane/bff/strategies/se: Generalized list_strategy_summaries_hide_retired_unfiltered_page to work for any page_size and page_token when hide_retired_personas=true and no state/exclude_state/persona_id filter is set, using 1 unfiltered first page (page_size=200) plus 1 bounded non-draft walk (exclude_state=draft, page_size=200) instead of scanning all 17 pages of unbound draft strategies.
services/control-plane/bff/strategies/ro: Routed all unfiltered hide_retired_personas=true list requests (regardless of page_size or page_token) through list_strategy_summaries_hide_retired_unfiltered_page.

dataset_shape.payload_shape: Real strategy_spec payload (~2.2 KB JSONB per row with indicators, signal_logic, market_scope, execution_profile, risk_constraints, evaluation_summary, governance, provenance, and metadata)

bff_hide_retired_personas_unfiltered_ove.dataset: 3,217 unbound drafts + 134 retired-persona approved + 5 running-persona paper_running + 21 idle-persona review + 2 unbound approved + 200 retired strategies = 3,579 rows

ac1_bounded_full_field_extraction_and_pe.details: Verified with _SpyMapping on heavy spec keys, store.full_summary_rows_extracted, and Postgres SQL spy that default page (page_size=20) extracts full fields for only 20 rows, persona_id filter extracts full fields for only the 2 matching rows (and 0 when unmatched), and non-returned rows have 0 heavy spec leaf accesses.

ac2_view_response_parity_across_all_row_.details: Compared legacy full-extraction projection against bounded two-phase projection across 29 query combinations covering multi-version semver/timestamp ordering, retired/draft/unknown lifecycles, all 9 persona_id metadata/spec locations, and tenant visibility (tenant-dev, tenant-other, legacy global).

ac3_bff_hide_retired_personas_bounded_re.details: Verified GET /bff/strategies?hide_retired_personas=true&page_size=20 (and page_size=25, page_token=20) over 3,379 active strategies makes exactly 2 registry reads (page_size=200 unfiltered + page_size=200&exclude_state=draft) and extracts 362 full rows total instead of 17 full scans.

ac4_cpu_drop_at_least_70_percent.details: Measured >= 88% CPU reduction in-process and >= 89.6% (default page) / >= 91.4% (persona-filtered call) combined Postgres + Registry Python CPU reduction against real PostgreSQL 16 over 3,400 current + 600 retired strategy families.

ac5_error_contracts_preserved.details: Verified invalid page_token returns 400 VALIDATION_FAILED (both before store access and on BFF), conflicting state + exclude_state returns 400 VALIDATION_FAILED, corrupt owner entry returns 500 REGISTRY_CORRUPT_ENTRY, and owner unavailability returns 503 OWNER_UNAVAILABLE.

ac6_no_existing_test_weakened_or_deleted.changed_assertions_justification: No existing test assertion was weakened or deleted. In services/registry/test_service.py::test_strategy_spec_summary_page_view_tenant_scope_filters_pagination_and_sql_projection, added an extra assertion verifying strategy_spec_summary_index_rows_from_columns alongside the existing strategy_spec_summary_rows_from_columns check.
